chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī Zayd, who said:
Al-Riḍā عليه السلام was asked about the properly slaughtered skins of foxes, and he said: Do not perform salat (prayer) in them.

key_terms.الذَّكِيَّةِ: properly slaughtered according to ritual law

ai.seo_question: Can one perform salat (prayer) while wearing properly slaughtered fox skins according to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام concerning salat (prayer) in fox skins. Even if the fox skins are from animals slaughtered properly, the Imam عليه السلام instructs that one should not perform salat (prayer) in them.
